_comment: Test-only Firebase config. Runs the Firestore emulator WITHOUT a rules file (open access) so the multi-tenant, unauthenticated data-layer transaction tests (vitest.emulator.config.ts) and the rules tests (which upload firestore.rules themselves via @firebase/rules-unit-testing) share one open emulator. The Storage emulator IS given storage.rules (it can't boot without a rules file); the storage rules test uploads its own copy via @firebase/rules-unit-testing anyway. Production rules live in firebase.json.
